# Barakah Bazaar - Premium Organic & Wellness Products
> Handcrafted Bridal Ubtan, 100% Pure Cold-Pressed Coconut Oil, and Traditional Natural Beauty Formulations.

## About Us
Barakah Bazaar is an artisanal e-commerce brand offering heritage wellness and personal care essentials. We specialize in small-batch bridal skincare, cold-pressed virgin coconut oil, and all-natural botanicals prepared according to time-tested ancestral recipes with 100% pure ingredients.

## Core Categories
- **Bridal**: Traditional handmade Bridal Ubtan, Bridal Radiance Face Masks, and Haldi ceremony sets.
- **Naturals**: Chemical-free herbal face packs, floral toners, saffron glow serums, and rose powders.
- **Coconut Oil**: 100% wood-pressed (ghani) and cold-pressed extra virgin coconut oil for hair, skin, and culinary wellness.
